texts.title: The benefits of learning a second language
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Learning a second language is one of the most rewarding things you can do. Research shows that bilingual people often have better memory and problem-solving skills than those who speak only one language. In addition, speaking another language opens up career opportunities. Many companies prefer employees who can communicate with international clients. However, learning a language requires time and patience. It is not something you can achieve overnight. Experts recommend practising a little every day rather than studying for hours once a week. The most important thing is to enjoy the process, because motivation is the key to success.

questions.explanation: The article says experts recommend practising a little every day.

questions.question: What is the key to success according to the article?
questions.explanation: The article says motivation is the key to success.

texts.title: The benefits of exercise
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Regular exercise is one of the best things you can do for your health. Studies show that people who exercise at least three times a week have lower stress levels and sleep better. Exercise also helps to prevent heart disease and other serious illnesses. However, many people say they do not have time to exercise. The good news is that you do not need to spend hours at the gym. Even a 30-minute walk every day can make a big difference. The most important thing is to choose an activity you enjoy, because then you will want to continue. Exercise should not feel like a punishment.

texts.title: Living in a big city
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Living in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages. On the positive side, cities offer more job opportunities, better public transport and a wider choice of entertainment. You can find restaurants from every country, museums, theatres and concerts. However, cities are also noisy, crowded and expensive. The cost of housing is often very high, and many people spend hours commuting to work every day. Some people decide to move to the countryside to enjoy a quieter life, but then they miss the excitement of the city. In my opinion, the ideal situation is to live in a medium-sized city, where you have opportunities but also some peace and quiet.

texts.title: The problem with plastic
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in the ocean. This is a serious problem because plastic does not break down quickly. It can take hundreds of years to disappear. Sea animals often mistake plastic for food, and many die as a result. Some countries have started to ban single-use plastics like bags and straws, and many shops now encourage customers to bring their own bags. However, experts say that individual actions are not enough. Governments and companies must take bigger steps to reduce plastic production. Recycling is important, but it is not the complete solution. The real answer is to use less plastic in the first place.

texts.title: Learning online vs learning in a classroom
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Online learning has become very popular in recent years, especially after the pandemic. It offers many advantages: you can study from home, choose your own schedule and save money on transport. However, it also has disadvantages. Some students find it difficult to concentrate at home, and they miss the interaction with teachers and classmates. In a traditional classroom, students can ask questions immediately and work in groups, which helps them learn faster. Research suggests that the best approach may be a combination of both methods. For example, students could attend some classes in person and complete other tasks online. This way, they benefit from the flexibility of online learning and the social aspect of the classroom.

texts.title: The history of the internet
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: The internet was invented in the 1960s by scientists working for the US government. At first, it was only used by universities and the military. In the 1990s, the World Wide Web made the internet available to everyone. Suddenly, people could send emails, read news and buy things online. Since then, the internet has changed almost every part of our lives. We use it for work, education, entertainment and communication. However, this has also created new problems, such as online addiction and privacy concerns. Many experts believe that we need to find a better balance between our online and offline lives.

texts.title: Why reading is important
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Reading is one of the most valuable habits you can develop. People who read regularly tend to have larger vocabularies and better writing skills. Reading also improves concentration and reduces stress. Studies have shown that just six minutes of reading can reduce stress levels by up to 68 percent. Unfortunately, many people say they are too busy to read. However, reading does not require a lot of time. You can read on the bus, during your lunch break or before going to sleep. The key is to choose books you enjoy, not books you feel you should read. Whether it is fiction, non-fiction or comics, the important thing is to read something every day.

questions.explanation: The article says people who read regularly tend to have larger vocabularies.

texts.title: The importance of breakfast
texts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer A, B, C or D.
texts.text: Many people skip breakfast because they say they do not have time in the morning. However, nutritionists agree that breakfast is the most important meal of the day. After eight hours of sleep, your body needs energy to start working properly. People who eat breakfast tend to concentrate better at school or work. They are also less likely to eat unhealthy snacks during the day. A good breakfast should include protein, fruit and whole grains. It does not need to be complicated - a simple bowl of cereal with milk and a banana is enough. The key is to make breakfast a habit, not an exception.
